The following events took place in '''2203 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]] was established, being used as a shortcut for [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] transport between [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Player Tapani">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref> This bypass was a spur of the longer [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], which was established circa [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]].
